preparationMode: scheduled planning only; generate full issue interactively after explicit publish trigger

japaneseLearningContract.goal: advanced practical Japanese: background knowledge, naturalness, nuance, and professional usage rather than English-style comprehension drills
requiredNewModules: 自然な言い換え・ニュアンス
japaneseLearningContract.costPolicy: Keep the Japanese section near the previous total generation cost by shortening the core article and replacing low-value drill modules instead of only adding more content.

historyContract.legacyIssue: manifest entry with href; open preserved original article page
historyContract.previewIssue: manifest entry with kind=preview; never set manifest.latest to a preview
historyContract.deprecatedHubBehavior: redirect to Learning v2 current/history entry
historyContract.legacyArticlePages: preserve original layout and functionality; do not rewrite during normal publishing

preflight: Use repository tom4318679/tom4318679.github.io exactly. learning-v2 is a directory only; never search for a repository named learning-v2.
Read this file directly from the fixed repository before every scheduled preparation and publish.
Read learning-v2/manifest.json live before every scheduled preparation and publish; never rely on a remembered latest date.
The scheduled task prepares topics and structure only. It does not need to persist full article payloads.
After the user explicitly triggers publishing, generate the full 5 English + 3 Japanese issue in that same interactive turn using the prepared topics and current contracts.
Do not ask the user to reconfirm repository, branch, learning-v2 path, or whether a prepared payload file exists.
Do not create a new YYYY-MM-DD directory for daily content.
If the target issue already exists, verify it first and update only incomplete or incorrect files; do not duplicate files.
publishOrder: Directly read publish-config.json and manifest.json from the fixed repository; do not perform repository discovery.
Generate the full issue interactively after the explicit publish trigger.
Write or verify 5 English part JSON files.
Write or verify 3 Japanese part JSON files using japaneseLearningContract.
Write or verify learning-v2/data/YYYY-MM-DD.json with all 8 part references and validation metadata.
Read back all 8 parts plus the issue descriptor and verify counts/status.
Update learning-v2/manifest.json last, only after the issue is complete.
Read back manifest.json and confirm latest points to the completed issue, never a preview.
Verify the public reader route /learning-v2/?date=YYYY-MM-DD can resolve through the same data contract.
neverDo: Never treat learning-v2 as a standalone repository.
Never search for a repository named learning-v2.
Never ask the user to reconfirm the fixed repository, branch, or project path.
Never require a previously persisted full payload as a prerequisite when the scheduled task intentionally uses planning-only preparation.
Never update manifest.latest before the issue files are complete.
Never set manifest.latest to a preview issue.
Never create daily content under learning-v2/YYYY-MM-DD/.
Never modify preserved legacy article pages or data/legacy during a normal daily publish.
Never use stale conversation history as the source of truth for repository path, latest issue, or file layout.
failurePolicy: If direct access to the fixed repository's publish-config.json or manifest.json fails, stop without changing manifest and report the exact failing step.
If GitHub write/read-back fails, leave manifest.latest unchanged until the issue is complete.
If any part fails validation, do not update manifest.latest.
If a partial issue exists, resume idempotently from the missing or invalid files instead of starting a second copy.

keep: interactive full generation after explicit publish trigger
Learning v2 current/history are the only navigation hubs
ignore: old standalone HTML/TXT storage details during normal publishing
old assumption that learning-v2 is a repository
old requirement to persist a full prepared payload before publishing
